description.text:
True Mystery (真实玄虚) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 7 November 2025 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It is about the Paradox Pokémon, said to come from the ancient past or the future, which live almost only in Area Zero, the unknown world inside Paldea's Great Crater. They appear as Ancient and Future cards, and the Future Pokémon Iron Valiant is on its cover. Many of its Trainers are Ancient or Future cards too, made to work with those Pokémon, such as the Ancient and Future Booster Energy Capsules, and it has the Supporters Professor Sada's Vitality and Professor Turo's Scenario.

Its Pokémon ex include Roaring Moon ex, Great Tusk ex, Sandy Shocks ex, Iron Hands ex, Iron Treads ex and Iron Valiant ex, along with Froslass ex, Tyranitar ex and Skeledirge ex. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Its main cards are numbered out of 128; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 163.
